title: Trade Monitoring Engineer
jobDescription:

We specialize in transforming deep market insights into sophisticated, automated trading strategies across diverse asset classes. By combining advanced mathematical models with cutting-edge technology, we build scalable, resilient, and high-performance trading systems. title: Graduate-Trading Technology & Research Engineer
jobDescription: About Quadeye: Quadeye is a leading global algorithmic trading firm operating across major exchanges. Our engineers transform deep market insights into automated trading strategies across multiple asset classes using advanced mathematical and engineering techniques. We are a team of entrepreneurial thinkers, strong coders, and problem-solvers who build resilient, robust, and ultra-fast trading systems. Quadeye fosters a culture of curiosity, high ownership, collaboration, and innovation—supported by world-class mentors, technology, and resources. Role Overview(Systems Engineer): We are looking for exceptional Systems Engineers to design and optimize high-performance trading systems that power our proprietary strategies. You will work on systems engineered for nanosecond-level performance and contribute to building a reliable and scalable trading infrastructure. This role is ideal for individuals eager to innovate, solve complex technical challenges, and accelerate their career in a high-impact environment. Role Overview(Quantitative Strategist): We are looking for high performing individuals who are eager to learn, invent and make some serious money in the process. We are looking to hire Quantitative Strategists who are excited to develop automated strategies for proprietary trading. The strategies would be targeted to explore different exchanges, asset classes and frequencies. You will be working with other exceptional software and quantitative professionals and solve some of the most challenging engineering problems. Requirements Responsibilities(Systems Engineer): Design and implement real-time trade execution and risk systems with nanosecond latency requirements Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks to make systems faster and more efficient Research opportunities to cut latency across OS, kernel, networking stack, kernel bypass, CPU architecture, algorithms, and cache-efficient data structures Collaborate with engineers and quants to build robust, scalable system components Responsibilities(Quantitative Strategist): Using cutting edge statistical and machine learning techniques to identify opportunities from terabytes of data Design and implement trading strategies into a highly-optimized and nimble code Productionize your strategies; investigate, observe and devise new ideas for better and faster predictions Ideal Candidate(Systems Engineer): Engineering degree in Computer Science or related fields from premier institutes Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and OOP (C++/C preferred) Strong problem-solving skills and programming fundamentals Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment Good communication skills and strong work ethic Working knowledge of Linux; familiarity with Python, Perl, R, or functional programming is a plus Ideal Candidate(Quantitative Strategist): Good problem solving skills and quantitative aptitude Strong background in data structures, algorithms and object-oriented programming, preferably in C++ or C Ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment Strong work ethics and communication skills Working knowledge of Linux Knowledge of Python,Perl, R or functional programing is a plus Eligibility Criteria: Minimum CGPA: 8.5 No active backlogs during application or selection Eligible Courses: B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering B.Tech Mathematics & Computing B.Tech Electrical Engineering Dual Degree programs in these disciplines Benefits Benefits: All meals & snacks provided Group health and term insurance Annual offsite & team parties 6 weeks paid vacation In-house physiotherapist Uber credits Cult membership Free annual health checkups

title: Linux Engineer - L2/ L3
jobDescription: Quadeye is one of the largest India-based proprietary trading firms. Since inception, we have consistently grown at a handsome rate and have a distinct track record of success behind us. We run a stable business spread globally across various asset classes. Our greatest strength is our work culture which takes a collaborative and non-hierarchical approach against an opposing prevalence in the industry. We strive as one team to stay ahead of the competition all the time. We are looking to hire Linux Engineers to manage and administer the Linux computing systems hardware, software and storage infrastructure that allow our trading strategies to run 24/7. The aim is to support and manage the trading infrastructure for uniquely customized systems of Quadeye. Your responsibilities will include: Provide direct technical support of Linux and related technology in a production/live trading environment Providing hands-on support for production issues related to colo/trading, office and data center environments Support and Administer firewall environment Assist in monitoring and troubleshooting of linux based servers, which include supporting hardware changes, software installations, and upgrades Tuning and optimizing servers for low latency Requirements 3+ Years of experience in Industry Engineering degree in Computer Science or any other discipline Exposure on installation, troubleshooting in Linux (Cent OS, Ubuntu) environment with experience in Firewall and Security Strong Knowledge of Shell/Python scripting Hands on experience in Monitoring Tools like Ansible / Zabbix Hands on experience on AWS services like EC2 and S3 Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple high priority projects Ability to learn new technologies quickly Good communication skills

title: Quantitative Developer
jobDescription: We are looking for a Quant Developer to join our high-performance trading team. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, trading operations, and quantitative infrastructure. You'll work closely with traders, researchers, and engineers to build automation tools, monitor production systems, generate trading analytics, and ensure smooth day-to-day trading operations. This is an excellent opportunity for engineers who enjoy solving real-world problems in a fast-paced, low-latency trading environment while building scalable tools that directly impact production. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain pre-trading setup pipelines, including trading file generation and validation. Generate and automate post-trading reports to support trading and research teams. Perform Simulation vs Production (Sim vs Prod) analysis to identify performance gaps and improve production reliability. Build and maintain production latency reports and monitor system performance. Generate and analyze production alpha performance reports to evaluate live trading performance. Develop statistical reports and dashboards for trading performance monitoring. Build basic predictors and analytical utilities as required by trading and research teams. Design and develop scripts and automation tools to streamline operational workflows. Support Trading Platform (TP) and binary movements/deployments, ensuring smooth production rollouts. Troubleshoot production issues and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system stability. Continuously identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks and improve infrastructure efficiency. Preferred Skills Exposure to algorithmic or high-frequency trading environments. Understanding of financial markets and trading workflows. Experience working with production monitoring, reporting, or analytics systems. Familiarity with SQL and data analysis. Knowledge of C++ is an added advantage. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes is a plus. Requirements 1–8 years of experience in Software Development, Quant Development, Trading Infrastructure, or Production Engineering. Strong programming skills in Python/C++ (mandatory). Good understanding of Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting. Experience writing automation scripts and production utilities. Strong analytical and debugging skills. Knowledge of Git and software development best practices. Ability to work in a fast-paced, production-critical environment.
